a.speaker: dev
a.text: Careful, half these cabinets are prototypes. The other half are older prototypes.

choices.text: What do you play around here?

skye.speaker: dev
skye.text: A rival publisher took her. Classic industry move.

proof.speaker: dev
proof.text: Proof? Look at their logo. That’s a guilty logo.

build.speaker: dev
build.text: Toy Plane: Alien Assault. Toy planes dogfight through a full-size city, and the gaps between buildings become the race course.

play.speaker: dev
play.text: Who’s the Smartest?, if you like trivia. Or Squad Dungeon, if you have an hour and opinions about ten classes.

end.speaker: dev
end.text: Don’t press the big red button on cabinet three. It doesn’t do anything. That’s the problem.
